scenes.title: Three Stones North
scenes.summary: At dawn on Saturday before the upstairs guests wake, Klara, Werner, and Martin count three flat flagstones north from the courtyard shade tree.

scenes.title: Wrapped in Waxed Cloth
scenes.summary: Miriam brings hot morning coffee from the kitchen just as Werner lifts the third stone and uncovers a dry parcel wrapped in heavy waxed cloth.

scenes.title: The Biscuit Tin
scenes.summary: Inside sunlit Room 9, Klara, Miriam, and Martin untie the waxed cloth to reveal a painted red-and-gold biscuit tin sealed thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: The Brass Compass
scenes.summary: Werner eases open the stiff tin lid with a drop of oil, and he and Klara discover a shining brass pocket compass resting on top.

scenes.title: Four Illustrated Cards
scenes.summary: Room 4 guest Helga and architect Lukas examine four watercolour clue cards from the tin, and Lukas recognises the signature mark of his retired cartography professor.

scenes.title: Half of a Cake Recipe
scenes.summary: In the café corner, Miriam, Helga, and Moritz read a neatly torn card holding only the top half of the famous summer berry-and-almond cake recipe.

scenes.title: Five Young Friends
scenes.summary: Martin, Helga, and Lukas admire a thirty-year-old charcoal sketch from the bottom of the tin showing five smiling friends around a courtyard table.

scenes.title: Walk All Four Clues First
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Klara, Werner, and Lukas inspect a small wax-sealed envelope instructing them to walk all four neighbourhood clues along Lindengasse before breaking the seal.
